description: Lakes: Reference Waterbodies is a polygon dataset with COMID. Reference waterbodies will be used for Adhoc Lakes that are only found in Reference Waterbodies. The entire Reference Waterbodies file is not run.

path.description: Source path. LakesConfig will inject preceding input path.
path.title: Path

run.description: Flag to run Reference Waterbodies input. Must be set to false if file is not present.
run.title: Run

fp_associated_path.description: A temporary layer to read waterbodies from where flowpaths have been associated and attributes joined. Skips flowpath association.
fp_associated_path.title: Fp Associated Path

flowpath_association_method.description: Type of flowpath association. Options are `polygon_outlet` or `nearest_point`
flowpath_association_method.title: Flowpath Association Method

search_radius_m.description: Distance from flowpath to search when associating flowpaths.
search_radius_m.title: Search Radius M

output_id_field.description: ID field to change name to for reference waterbodies
output_id_field.title: Output Id Field

intersection_length_min_m.description: Minimum prefered intersection length when associating polygons with flowpaths. If the flowpath intersection is extremely short, it can sometimes be almost entirely on a long downstream flowpath.
intersection_length_min_m.title: Intersection Length Min M

attrib_src_path.description: Source file for joining attributes from another file. It will be skipped if null.
attrib_src_path.title: Attrib Src Path

attrib_src_layer.description: Source file layer for importing attributes
attrib_src_layer.title: Attrib Src Layer

attrib_src_key.description: Source file key to match when importing attributes
attrib_src_key.title: Attrib Src Key

title: RefWaterbodyInput
